data.key: Fighter Roughrider ~ Leap from the Saddle
data.name: Leap from the Saddle
data.description: At 7th level, after a roughrider's mount takes a single move, he may attempt a fast dismount (DC 20 Ride check). If he succeeds, he can take a full attack action. This ability replaces armor training 2.
